items.author: anguzo
items.body:
### Description

**Summary:**
When running `bunx skills add kreuzberg-dev/kreuzberg` (or similar add commands via Vercel's open agent skills tool, vercel-labs/skills), the tool attempts to fetch a GitHub authentication token by directly invoking `gh auth token` using Node.js's execSync. 

---
This behavior is surprising and suspicious from a security standpoint, as it attempts to extract credentials from a local developer environment (via GitHub CLI) without explicit user consent or documented awareness. It was discovered during a security audit after the "skills" tool was tagged as suspicious
items.title: [Bug]: Invasive credential retrieval: 'skills add' invokes 'gh auth token' via Node.js execSync without user consent
